steps.title: Install Homebrew (already installed)
steps.explanation: Homebrew is a free helper for installing command-line tools. This Mac already has it, so you can skip this step. The command downloads and runs a script from the internet, so do not run it unless you need it.
concerns: Downloads and runs a script from the internet without you checking it

steps.title: Install wget
steps.explanation: This uses Homebrew to add the wget program to your Mac. It only adds this one tool.

steps.title: Check that wget works
steps.explanation: This asks wget for its version number. If a number appears, the install worked.
